clips.title: The story
paras: The Forgotten Pools draw wildlife, Kolkar centaur, and the Horde into a contest for water in the northern Barrens. Northwest of the Crossroads, subterranean springs feed an oasis amid the dry savanna.

Fresh water gathers in the Forgotten Pools, where thick reeds, palm trees, and Laden Mushrooms grow beside the parched Barrens. Plainstriders, snapjaw turtles, and zhevras come to drink. Kolkar centaur keep a camp along the banks and guard the water from travelers, bringing them into conflict with Horde travelers from the Crossroads. Wildlife, Kolkar, and the Horde all contend for the oasis.

Deviate Fish thrive in the Forgotten Pools, one of the region’s rare surface waters where they can be found. Their presence hints at deeper ties to the strange transformative energies altering the Barrens’ water table. Horde naturalists and scouts watch the waters and unusual fungi along the banks, wary of what may be seeping into the soil.
